reviews.title: La mejor cpu alta gama calidad - precio
reviews.comment: Me sorprendió esta cpu. La verdad no entiendo por qué le tiran odio a intel sabiendo que este procesador es una excelente opción, rinde de una manera espectacular, casi no se calienta y consume poca energía. Lo recomiendo y más si lo encuentran a buen precio
reviews.author: walter

reviews.title: Awesomesauce!
reviews.comment: After tuning, single core scores in 13900ks range, multi core is as fast as 14900k.  Awesome productivity chip for the money and great for gaming too.
reviews.author: maestro0428

reviews.title: Too expensive, wait for a sub-$250 sale
reviews.comment: I got this on a crazy sale price of $224. Don't buy this unless you get a great deal like that. Just buy AMD otherwise. Very good raw processing power, so good if you're building a combo workstation/gaming PC like I did, but again only at a lower price. $300+ is crazy when you can have a Ryzen 7 for $260.
reviews.author: Maestro2442

reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.comment: Totalmente funcional, en conjunto con los componentes brinda experiencia completa.
reviews.author: Diego

reviews.title: Get right version of this cpu
reviews.comment: Make sure you get the right version of the chip- this one doesn't have video included and I returned it, unopened.
